Our analysis

Of the 106 medium SUVs in our comparison, the Citroën C5 Aircross Hybrid is the 33rd cheapest to own.

Its biggest cost is depreciation: €20,940 over 5 years, 60% of the total.

FAQ

How much does a Citroën C5 Aircross Hybrid cost per month?

About €580 a month at 15,000 km a year over 5 years, including depreciation, energy, insurance, servicing and road tax. That's €0.464 per km.

Which DGT label does the Citroën C5 Aircross Hybrid have?

The ECO label.
